title: Driver
description: The person. The driver app's own record. Added by PRD-2 section 0.16.
x-reads: driverapp: own only, scoped by the driverId claim, field-restricted
x-pii: This doc holds PII. The driver's read rule MUST be field-restricted, not just collection-scoped. A collection-level rule still returns the whole document, and the raw phone would leak through it.

phoneMasked.description: The MASKED phone. The mask is applied at the source by upsertDriver, not by the reader. The raw phone lives in staffPhones/{code}.

vanId.description: The van allotted to this driver. The device-claim callable checks this, so a driver with a valid code cannot claim a van that is not theirs.

wardIds.description: The driver's allotted wards. Snapshotted into the trip at shift start.
